subject: Reserved commit & ramp plan for Dedicated GPUs — Polaris Health
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@polarishealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@polarishealth.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Dedicated capacity ask and timelines

Diego / Marissa —

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. Polaris is interested in a Dedicated deployment to support our clinical summarization and triage workloads. A few specifics from our side so you can build a committed offer:

- Target baseline at go-live: equivalent of 4x A100-class GPUs (sustained inference).
- Peak steady-state target: scale to equivalent of 12x A100-class GPUs within first 90 days.
- Preferred contract length: 24 months (we're open to 12 or 36 if pricing materially changes).
- Throughput / latency expectations: deliver >= 1,200 tokens/sec aggregate for our mixed seq distribution, and p95 latency < 300ms at baseline load.
- Compliance: audit logs and data residency in us-central1.

Can you send a committed-pricing matrix (12/24/36M) with ramp schedules, onboarding milestones, and any credits/penalties tied to missed capacity start dates? Attached is a short RFP summary.

We'd like to move quickly — ideally have an internal procurement review by Nov 25.

—Emma
Emma Li
Head of AI Platforms, Polaris Health
emma.li@polarishealth.com
Attachment: Polaris_RFP_summary.xlsx (xlsx, 36KB)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Follow-up: Dedicated capacity ask and timelines

Looping you both — I sketched out a few defensible options to present. High-level assumptions: A100-equivalent pricing baseline, dedicated pool with autoscale headroom, and standard onboarding (networking, VPC peering, KMS).

Option A (12 months, fastest pricing):
- Committed baseline: 4 GPUs (A100-eq), ramp to 12 over 90 days.
- Discount: 8% off list for 12M commit.
- SLA: 99.5% uptime; p95 latency SLO best-effort, credits as below.

Option B (24 months, balanced):
- Same sizing; ramp front-loaded: 50% capacity available within 30 days, 100% within 60 days.
- Discount: 16% off list.
- Throughput guarantee: 1,200 tokens/sec (measured as 5-min rolling avg).
- SLA credits: 5% monthly credit per missed uptime window; acceleration credit if we miss 60-day target (1 week onramp credit per week delayed, capped at 8 weeks).

Option C (36 months, deepest discount):
- Discount: 24% off list.
- Additional: one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of first-quarter committed spend if they sign within 14 days of proposal.

Notes / Points to confirm with Polaris:
- Do they require strict latency SLOs with monetary credits, or are credits tied only to capacity delivery?
- Is 60-day full capacity acceptable if they want deeper discount?

I'm attaching a quick pricing matrix so we can iterate numbers before sending the customer-facing PDF. Also: recommend we offer a 60-day acceleration option (customer pays per-token list for accelerated days beyond advertised ramp).

Diego
Director, Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
Attachment: draft-pricing-matrix.csv (csv, 4KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@polarishealth.com>, procurement@polarishealth.com
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood proposal: Dedicated commit options & suggested ramp (Polaris Health)

Emma / Polaris procurement —

Thanks for the clear brief. Attached is a formal proposal that captures the three term paths Diego outlined plus operational milestones and acceptance criteria. Highlights below:

- We propose Option B (24 months) as the recommended balance between price and flexibility.
  - 16% committed discount.
  - 50% of committed capacity available within 30 calendar days of signed SOW; remaining 50% staged and available by day 60.
  - If Redwood misses a milestone, Polaris receives onboarding credits (applied to next invoice) and the option to increase priority for acceleration.
- Throughput guarantee: 1,200 tokens/sec aggregate (5-min rolling avg) at the committed pool size. SLA credits apply for downtime; latency-oriented credits are available as a separate add-on.
- Early termination: prorated termination fee based on remaining committed months (we offer an early-exit ladder for 24M where fee reduces after month 12).

Next steps we propose:
1) Confirm preferred term and ramp target (30/60 vs 60/90).
2) We provide a redline-ready SOW + pricing appendix; you return PO or signed DocuSign.
3) Kickoff (networking & security tasks) scheduled within 5 business days of signed SOW.

We're flexible on ramp cadence if Polaris needs a faster 50% in 2 weeks; we will show the incremental cost to accelerate.

Attaching Redwood_Proposal_Polaris_v1.pdf for internal procurement review. Happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk the SOW.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachment: Redwood_Proposal_Polaris_v1.pdf (pdf, 128KB)
From: Emma Li <emma.li@polarishealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@polarishealth.com, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal: Dedicated commit options & suggested ramp (Polaris Health)

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear options. A few clarifications from procurement:

- Polaris prefers the 24M (Option B) if we can move the full 100% to be available by day 60 (your proposal already states 60, confirmed). That aligns with our release schedule.
- We'd like the 50% milestone to be achievable within 14 business days instead of 30. If you can meet that without >12% cost uplift, we're okay. Please spell out the acceleration charge.
- Early termination: we need a cap on the termination fee for force majeure and a clear ramp credit if Redwood misses supply deadlines.
- SLA credits: procurement needs an explicit formula (e.g., credit = (percent of downtime beyond SLO) * monthly committed spend * 0.5).

Can we schedule a 30-min call Wednesday (Nov 18) to review SOW redlines? Procurement needs final numbers by Nov 25 for our board packet.

—Emma
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@polarishealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Redwood proposal: Dedicated commit options & suggested ramp (Polaris Health)

Emma —

Appreciate the specificity — below are concrete commitments and the wording we'll put in the SOW so procurement has clear verbiage. I'm also attaching the DocuSign envelope link for the initial SOW once they confirm term.

1) Ramp & start dates
- Agreed: 24M (Option B) recommended.
- Delivery cadence: 50% of committed capacity available within 14 business days of signed SOW; 100% available within 60 calendar days. If Polaris requests >50% in 7 business days, acceleration is possible at +10% of committed monthly price (pro-rated) for the accelerated period.

2) SLA / credits
- Uptime SLO: 99.5% monthly. If monthly uptime < 99.5%, Polaris receives a credit equal to (99.5% - measured uptime)% * monthly committed spend * 0.75.
- Capacity delivery credit: if Redwood fails to reach 50% by 14 business days, Polaris receives onboarding credit equal to 5% of that month's invoice for each full week of delay beyond the milestone, capped at 20%.

3) Early termination & force majeure
- Standard termination ladder for 24M: month 1-6 = 60% of remaining committed value; months 7-12 = 40%; months 13-24 = 20%.
- Force majeure: termination fee waived if event qualifies under mutually agreed force majeure clause; otherwise we follow a negotiated mid-way path.

4) Next steps
- I'll update the SOW with exact milestone dates and the credit formulas above and send for redline.
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/tx/5a8b2f-polairs-sign (placeholder) — once Polaris confirms term and acceleration target, we'll push the envelope.

If this looks good, Marissa can issue the formal SOW packet. Happy to review on Wed 11/18 — I can do 10:00am PT.

Diego
Director, Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
Diego Fernandez | diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0127
